verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly publish a developer API with an interactive reference, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no API reference, runnable examples, or developer portal of any kind. The probes record only bot walls (an Akamai 403 and Imperva Incapsula interstitials) on both www.nvsos.gov and the esos/orion filing portal, and they say nothing about an API.
